name: neuro-nudge-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for Neuro-Nudge push notifications

scripts.sync-core: rm -f src/meditation-core/*.ts && mkdir -p src/meditation-core && cp ../src/utils/meditation/*.ts src/meditation-core/ && rm -rf meditation-assets && mkdir -p meditation-assets/ambience && cp ../content/meditations/voice.json ../content/meditations/voices.json ../content/meditations/pronunciations.json ../assets/sounds/chime.wav meditation-assets/ && cp ../content/meditations/ambience/*.mp3 meditation-assets/ambience/
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
